newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures finish firmer in technical trade.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures finish firmer in technical trade.

text.p: FCOJ futures finished firmer as the market bucked its recent trend of backing off gains by the close.
Market sources said today's rally was technically driven and dismissed the effect of Mediterranean fruit fly sightings.
"Always sell into a bug story; they never pan out," a Florida broker said.
The sprayings scheduled to begin later this week should rid groves of the pests, which are more harmful to fresh fruit than to the processed fruit industry, analysts said.
The other fundamenal factors remain extremely bearish as no change is expected in USDA's next Florida crop estimate,due for release June 12.
The last report pegged the crop at a record 224.2 million 90-lb boxes, and yields at 1.58 gallons per box.
"We'll never be able to drink all that juice," the broker said. "Until retail prices come down, supplies will weigh on the market and we could test the low end of the trading range."
Support was pegged at 72.00 cents a lb for July juice, with resistance at 80.80 cents.
July closed up 1.75 cents at 79.25 cents after trading from 79.90 to 77.75 cents. Second position September finished 1.80 cents higher at 81.35 cents.
Volume was estimated at 2,200 lots versus Tuesday's official 2,590 lots.
